name: Universidad Complutense de Madrid
summary: Public university in Madrid; business and economics can be taken in English at Somosaguas, and English Studies at Moncloa.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10); PCE tests, subject recognition or the PAU can add up to 4 points. Non-Spanish speakers must certify Spanish B2 unless the degree sets another level.

programmes.name: Administración y Dirección de Empresas (ADE) (en inglés)
programmes.about: Business administration with a specialisation in accounting, management, finance or marketing, and an external internship option; the degree can be taken 100% in English.
programmes.ib: Can be taken 100% in English. Madrid's Spanish B2 rule for non-Spanish speakers may apply; ask UCM before applying.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Madrid pre-enrolment, or through UCM's Early Admission if you live outside Spain.

programmes.name: Economía (en inglés)
programmes.about: Economics with a specialisation in economic analysis, the global economy, applied, monetary and financial or public economics; about 88% can be taken in English.
programmes.ib: Up to 88% of the degree in English, the rest in Spanish. Madrid's Spanish B2 rule for non-Spanish speakers may apply.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Madrid pre-enrolment, or through UCM's Early Admission if you live outside Spain.

programmes.name: Estudios Ingleses Plan 2022
programmes.about: English linguistics and literature at the Faculty of Philology; unless stated otherwise the language of instruction is English, with a second foreign language.
programmes.ib: Needs English B2 and Spanish B1; a few subjects are taught in Spanish.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Madrid pre-enrolment, or through UCM's Early Admission if you live outside Spain.

notes: Early Admission is for IB students whose family lives outside Spain; for 2026 it ran 20 January to 1 April 2026.
Physics, Maths–Physics, Computer Engineering, Law–Business and Economics–International Relations offer an English group inside a Spanish degree; how much is in English varies.
Most other UCM degrees are in Spanish, with some subjects in English.
